deploybot: Starting staging deploy for `staging` environment.
deploybot: tag=`v2.4.1-rc3`, commit=`abcdef1234`, initiated_by=@alice

ci-bot: CI checks complete — all pipelines green :white_check_mark:
ben: Quick ask — can we pin the reranker model to `reranker@v3.2` for this deploy? Want to avoid drift.
alice: good catch, ben. I pushed a pin to the staging config (`infra/staging/reranker_pin: v3.2`) before rollout.
carol: Any DB or migration steps? Trying to loop in data team if needed.
alice: No DB migrations in this release. Just model config + inference runtime tweak.
ben: standing by to rollback if latency > 120ms p95 or error rate > 1% within the canary.
alice: noted. smoke tests running: latency p95=95ms, error rate=0.2% so far.
deploybot: Canary propagation to 50% initiated.
alice: Observability looks clean. traces and token-costs within expected envelope.
carol: tagging release notes with a short blurb about quantization fallback and reranker pin.
ben: adding a short note about costs: expected -6% unit token cost under workload X.
alice: thumbs up. will hold final 100% until canary completes 5m stable window.
deploybot: Canary stable. shifting to 100%.
deploybot: Deploy complete for `staging` — status=SUCCESS. tag=`v2.4.1-rc3`, commit=`abcdef1234`.
